<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, breaks the N‑S bond of the sulfonamide and forms a sulfonyl‑chloride (S‑Cl) bond. The functional group formed in the forward reaction is a sulfonamide, which is present in the available functional‑group list. We'll search the template catalog for templates that form a sulfonamide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
